$comment: Provenance of this native fork; scripts/native-fork-diff.mjs reads it. Local delta includes observable shell.main centre ownership, delegated keyed-main rendering with native fallback, the stable main-tabs anchor, a frame-lifetime dock action registry, retained hidden dock views and a hidden native resource carrier throughout Workbench mode, and full-height right geometry with the bottom row confined to left plus centre, and an added status strip (StatusStrip.tsx) the frame renders under the columns, which apply() receives decorated so it reads the frame settings (hidden items, order) and wraps items that declare open in a button. The root registration also leaves a childless placeholder on the root context while the bundle hot-reloads (src/root-handoff.ts), so 'root' never renders without a registration. Update it with every upstream bump or delta change.
